name: Aminata Diallo
action: Aminata slows only a little, gives a small nod, and says, "No, thank you. I should keep walking."
reason: Aminata’s aching feet and the warm, sweet smell of the tea make the offer appealing, but she does not know the young man well enough to accept it. She also feels she should not stop there long, so she decides to be polite and keep going.
